description: Get the caption tracks and parsed transcript of a YouTube video on a connected channel (youtube only). Useful for repurposing video content into posts on other platforms. videoId is the YouTube video id (from get_post_analytics platformPostId or the watch URL).

accountId.description: Optional. The channel id (from list_accounts). Defaults to the first connected channel.

name: get_video_transcript
title: Get Video Transcript
